text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Fitted light gray short sleeve henley with open two-button placket, washed gray relaxed jeans, dark loafers. Black fine knit sweater folded beside outfit.. Add ONLY these accessories: Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses, both temples visible in three-quarter product view.; One classic silver metal bracelet wristwatch with simple light dial, shown alone.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.

Keep the gray henley shirt, gray jeans, shoes, black knit sweater as garment draped over shoulders, sunglasses and ONE silver watch. Preserve all other cuts, colors, proportions and fabric detail. Empty hollow clothes, no skin or mannequin, white seamless background, full outfit uncropped. Do not add anything.
